title: 第85章 桃李满天下
content_zh:
第85章 桃李满天下-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

上一章

存书签

下一章

大年初一去城隍庙上香，是老吴家雷打不动的保留节目。

虽说吴姜和老爷子心里都门儿清，如今端坐大殿之上的，早就不是自家那位老祖宗了，但该走的流程、该尽的恭敬，半分都不能少。

没多大功夫，一家人就赶到了城隍庙。

这里一如既往的人声鼎沸、香火旺盛，普通老百姓可不知道城隍爷换了人的事情。

排队好久，几人才挤进大殿。

老爷子率先上前，小心翼翼点燃三炷香，双手合十躬身下拜，磕了三个头才起来；紧接着是吴时安和王雅琴，两人也学着老爷子的模样，恭恭敬敬地上香磕头，进庙敬神的道理，自然是都懂的。

最后终于轮到吴姜，他拿起三炷香点燃，轻轻晃了晃熄灭火苗，对着城隍爷的神像拜了拜，这才将香稳稳插进香炉。

隐约间感知到，大殿之上的城隍爷神像，注视了他一眼。

吴姜跪在蒲团上，刚磕完一个头，就在准备磕第二个的时候，耳边突然传来一声急切又带着几分惊惧的声音：“不许磕头，赶紧起来！！”

吴姜一怔，茫然地抬起头，下意识扫视了一圈大殿，周遭的香客都在专心许愿，没人注意到这边，他随即把目光投向端坐高台的神像。

“别看了，就是我说的！赶紧起来，下次再来，也不许磕头行礼！”那声音再次响起，带着几分气急败坏。

吴姜心里瞬间了然，和他说话的，正是苍名县新来的城隍爷。

呵...这位城隍爷还挺客气。

既然是城隍爷的吩咐，吴姜也不矫情，顺势站起身，对着神像弯腰拱手行了一礼。

起身抬头的刹那，他眼角余光一瞥，不知是不是错觉，城隍爷手中握着的笏板，好像裂开了一道口子。

大殿外还有大把香客排队等着，一家人上完香，没多停留，就赶紧退了出去。

拜完城隍，几人又在庙里简单逛了一圈，便准备回去了。

Chapter 85 The world is full of peaches and plums - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

Going to the City God's Temple to offer incense on the first day of the Lunar New Year was a fixture in the Wu family's repertoire.

Although Wu Jiang and the old man knew clearly that the person sitting in the hall was no longer their ancestor, they still needed to follow the procedures and be respectful.

Without much effort, the family arrived at the Chenghuang Temple.

The place is as busy and bustling as ever, but ordinary people don't know that the City God has changed.

After queuing for a long time, only a few people squeezed into the main hall.

The old man stepped forward first, carefully lit three sticks of incense, put his hands together and bowed down, kowtowing three times before getting up; followed closely by Wu Shi'an and Wang Yaqin, who also followed the old man's example, respectfully put up the incense and kowtowed. Naturally, they both understood the principle of entering a temple to worship gods.

Finally, it was Wu Jiang's turn. He picked up three sticks of incense and lit them. He shook them gently to extinguish the flames, bowed to the statue of the City God, and then firmly inserted the incense into the incense burner.

He vaguely sensed that the statue of the City God above the main hall was looking at him.

Wu Jiang was kneeling on the futon. He had just kowtowed once, and when he was about to kowtow the second time, an urgent and somewhat frightened voice suddenly came from his ears: "Don't kowtow, get up quickly!!"

Wu Jiang was startled, raised his head blankly, and subconsciously glanced around the hall. The pilgrims around him were all concentrating on making wishes, and no one noticed. He then turned his attention to the statue of the god sitting on the high platform.

"Don't look, that's what I said! Get up quickly, and next time you come, you are not allowed to kowtow and salute!" The voice sounded again, with a bit of anger.

Wu Jiang knew instantly that the person talking to him was the new City God from Cangming County.

Ha...this city god is quite polite.

Since it was the City God's order, Wu Jiang did not show any pretense, stood up and bowed before the statue with his hands in hand.

The moment he stood up and raised his head, he glanced out of the corner of his eye and saw, whether it was an illusion or not, that there seemed to be a crack in the wat tablet held by the City God.

There were a large number of pilgrims waiting in line outside the main hall. After the family offered incense, they quickly left without stopping.

After paying homage to the City God, they took a brief walk around the temple and then prepared to go back.
